mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and improved corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to generate positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate above 4.0% signals active monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Core CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% annually signals persistent price pressures that may trigger aggressive central bank intervention, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >45% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized rate > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust supply chain capacity that supports corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to produce positive 5-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 118.0 (2017=100) signals supply chain disruption that reduces output and increases inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 118.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
